Following are some of theachievements of Jahangir:
Jahangir was a great patron of art and literature. He spent lavishly in building splendid
buildings,gardens,andmausoleums.
The Mughal paintingflourished during his reign.
The emperor was also known for his architectural work in variety of stones and
marbles.
Other major works of his time include the
constructionofMasajid,Sarais(lnns),andwells
ontheroadsides.
Tuzuk-i-Jahangiri or Jahanghir Nama is the
autobiographyof Mughal Emperor Jahanghir.It
includes the details like his ideas on art, politics,
andinformationabouthisfamily.

Shahabuddin ShahJahan
ShahJahan ascended the throne of Mughal Empire in1628ADand continued the policies
of the Great Mughal rulers. He extended the Mughal rule into the South of India by
conquering the Deccan states.Shah Jahan reinforced the empire by building a massive
army. It is said that his army consisted of a huge number of soldiers. He also made
advancementof cannons atlarge scale.
